basis_statement: Retries remain safe only while the same durable meaning still holds. Once safe retries are exhausted or source truth drifts, the runtime dead-letters or quarantines instead of looping blindly.

policy_rows.redrive_gate: Redrive is lawful only when the same command receipt, actor/session binding, and payload hash still match current truth.
policy_rows.terminal_posture: Dead-letter the packet and return the original durable command receipt rather than accepting a second command mutation.
notes: Commands should fail fast into deterministic receipts rather than spin in transport.

policy_rows.redrive_gate: Redrive requires the same manifest, stage code, command receipt, and precondition hash.
policy_rows.terminal_posture: Dead-letter after repeated safe retries and surface operator repair on the durable stage receipt.
notes: Late duplicate worker completions may be ignored unless adopted by a recovery manifest.

policy_rows.redrive_gate: Redrive requires the same immutable object version, event identity, and safety posture to remain valid.
policy_rows.terminal_posture: Dead-letter the packet and keep immutable object-version processing status explicit on the durable ledger.
notes: At-least-once event delivery must still converge to one processing outcome.

policy_rows.redrive_gate: Re-drive requires binding-lineage revalidation, duplicate-truth revalidation, and the same duplicate meaning bucket to remain lawful.
policy_rows.terminal_posture: Quarantine the packet after repeated safe retries so operator review can inspect request identity, token lineage, and stronger external truth.
notes: Authority transport failure is not permission to mint a fresh legal attempt.

policy_rows.redrive_gate: Re-drive requires the same canonical ingress receipt, authenticated channel proof, and source-record continuity.
policy_rows.terminal_posture: Quarantine ambiguous or drifted ingress instead of applying a speculative state transition.
notes: Ingress ambiguity is an investigation surface, not a silent retry loop.
